subject: Demo recap + proposed POC kickstart for Aquila Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@aquilahealth.com>, Brad Wells <brad.wells@aquilahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC kickstart for Aquila Health

Hi Sarah / Brad —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and a proposed 6-week POC runbook so we can lock on success criteria and owners. I captured the items we discussed and added a few suggestions based on similar healthcare pilots.

Demo highlights (short):
- Retrieval + rerank demo: vector index + lightweight reranker for clinical note search.
- Streaming generation for templated patient summaries.
- Observability: token-level cost telemetry, latency dashboards per route.

Proposed POC objectives (what success looks like):
1) Functional: Integrate Redwood API with Aquila search pipeline and generate patient-summary drafts from clinical notes.
2) Quality: 85%+ clinician-rated relevance on top-3 retrievals; summary precision >= 80% on a 50-sample blind eval.
3) Performance: p95 response latency < 250ms for retrieval path under baseline traffic (see worksheet).
4) Cost: incremental inference cost target <= $0.03 per 1k tokens for the read/summary workload (goal, tunable via quantization and batching).
5) Security/compliance: VPC peering and customer-managed keys (we'll propose config).

6-week POC sprint (proposed):
- Week 0 (prep): NDA/MPA + network checklist; share redwood-poc-worksheet.xlsx (attached).
- Week 1: Integration — auth, sample data ingestion to private index, network connectivity test.
- Week 2: Baseline metrics — collect latency, tokens, and quality on 100 queries.
- Week 3: Optimization — batching, caching, and model variant A/B test.
- Week 4: QA eval — clinician blind rating on 50–100 samples; produce final metrics.
- Week 5: Wrap & next steps — retrospective, recommended config for production, draft purchase/commit proposal.

Owners (initial):
- Redwood: Marcus (SE lead), Lauren (success metrics & onboarding).
- Aquila: Sarah (product owner), Brad (SRE/network lead).

Immediate asks for Aquila to unblock kickoff:
- Confirm two SRE contacts for network/VPC work and a general product PO (name + email).
- Approve the POC worksheet and the proposed kickoff week (suggested week of Oct 19).
- Provide a short set (20–50) of representative queries for the baseline run.

Attachments: redwood-poc-worksheet.xlsx (integration checklist + metric templates), network-requirements.pdf (VPC info).

If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for the kickoff and loop legal on a short MPA template.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

---

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@aquilahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Brad Wells <brad.wells@aquilahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC kickstart for Aquila Health

Thanks Marcus — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifying Qs before we lock on the week of Oct 19: 

1) Latency: is the p95 < 250ms target achievable on your hosted environment or do we need Dedicated capacity to hit that? We want to understand expected infra commitments.
2) Data handling: for the blind eval, what formats do you ingest? We’ll be sanitizing PHI but want to confirm acceptable sample formats and whether we should anonymize locally.
3) Access for SRE: Brad will need an SSH jump host / peering details and a network-reqs.pdf to share with our cloud team.

We can provide the product PO (that’s me) and our SRE (Brad). I’ll pull together 30 representative queries and aim to get them to you by Wed.

Also — can you share a short list of the model variants you think are good starting points? We’d like to avoid long-running experiments.

Sarah Jenkins
Senior Product Manager, Aquila Health
sarah.jenkins@aquilahealth.com

On Mon, Oct 12, 2026 at 09:12 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> [original message]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@aquilahealth.com>, Brad Wells <brad.wells@aquilahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC kickstart for Aquila Health

Great questions — answers and small adjustments below.

1) Latency: p95 < 250ms is achievable on Redwood Dedicated (small pool) for the retrieval path with our standard batching and KV prefix caching. On Hosted, p95 is typically ~300–500ms depending on traffic and sequence length; we can run a short smoke test on Hosted but recommend Dedicated for strict p95 SLOs.

2) Data formats: CSV exports of de-identified notes (UTF-8), NDJSON for structured metadata, or S3 buckets with ACL-based access work best. You can anonymize locally (preferred). We do not require PHI in our test — de-identified data is fine.

3) Network: attached network-requirements.pdf contains the peering checklist. Brad — if you can share your AWS account ID and preferred CIDR, our infra team will draft the peering request.

Model variants (recommended starters):
- rwd-small-qa (fast, cheaper; good for retrieval + rerank)
- rwd-medium-gen (balance of quality/latency for summaries)
- rwd-xq-lite (quantized option for cost experiments)

Action items if we lock Oct 19 kickoff: 
- Marcus: schedule kickoff, provision temporary test index, share baseline script.
- Lauren: define evaluation rubric and clinician rating form (will send Wed).
- Rishi: circulate short MPA and trial terms.
- Aquila (Sarah/Brad): provide 30 queries, AWS account ID for peering, and SRE contact for list above.

I’ll attach an initial evaluation worksheet and a weekly cadence template to the kickoff invite. If Oct 19 is tight, we can push a week — let me know.

Cheers,
Marcus

>
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Aquila POC — owners & quick prep checklist

Lauren / Rishi — looping you in so we can be prepared if Aquila confirms the Oct 19 kickoff. Key asks below: 

Lauren: please draft the clinician rating rubric (3–5 blinded criteria: relevance, correctness, hallucination risk, brevity) and a simple Google Sheet for tracking. Also include a short sampling plan (random + targeted edge cases).

Rishi: please prepare the 30-day trial MPA template with standard trial limits and the option for Dedicated short term (30 days). Also confirm commercial팀 contact for procurement review.

Other prep:
- Infra: temporary test index ready, baseline script (I have a skeleton)
- Legal: short MPA + data handling annex

I’ll wait for Sarah to send queries/payments details and will then schedule the kickoff meeting.

Thanks,
Marcus
